status: shipped for weapons: every per-weapon action comes from licensed private source audio (not ElevenLabs; the prompts below are kept for any clip regenerated later) and lives in the private repo APPARANYX/grasstex-audio (licence: no redistribution), overlaid by scripts/fetch_private_audio.sh and played from manifest.json categories weapon.<model>. That repo also holds the 17 pack guns the game does not field. Not recorded: shared casings and impacts here (flybys and impacts play from combat/, combat-sfx-manifest.json); mg42 barrelChange.
roster: battle/modules/53-fbx-soldier-backend.js WEAPON_MODELS: every weapon model listed there must have an entry here

rules.singleShot: Every clip with singleShot:true holds exactly one discharge: one onset, attack within the first 10 ms, no second transient above peak-18 dB. Automatic fire is built at runtime by retriggering fire at cyclicRpm with round-robin and no immediate repeat. Recorded bursts are rejected.
rules.tail: fireTail clips carry the reverb/echo tail only, with no transient. They play once at burst end so short single shots can stay dry.
rules.loudness: Shots and flybys level on the loudest 100 ms window per MASTERING.md; foley uses the foley target.
rules.keying: Runtime keys by weapon model (faction + model), not by sim kind, so a Thompson and an M1 Carbine sound different.
rules.voices: Voice pool per weapon >= ceil(cyclicRpm/60 * maxDurationS) + 2 so a fast MG never steals a playing round.
rules.format: 48 kHz mono source masters kept outside the repo; ship mono MP3, 128 kbps, no leading silence.
rules.generation: Each clip's "prompt" is fed to ElevenLabs Sound Effects (scripts/generate_weapon_sfx.py) one variation at a time; never pitch-shift one generation into several variations. Route stays fetch (into gitignored .runtime/) -> normalize_audio.sh -> register in manifest.json -> commit the MP3s only, same as Assets/audio's existing route.
rules.impacts: Impact material keys (impactFlesh/Dirt/Masonry/Wood/Metal/Vegetation) match 15-bullet-impact-fx.js's material()/holeKind() surface classification 1:1, so the runtime can key impact audio off the same decal the hit already picked.
rules.pathLayout: Shot/tail clips: weapons/<model>/<action>-NN.mp3 (mastering's smallArms -16 dBFS target, already matched by normalize_audio.sh's */weapons/*.mp3 catch-all). Every other per-weapon action (reload stages, bolt cycle, clip ping, stoppage click/clear, bipod): weapons/foley/<model>-<action>-NN.mp3, same subfolder the existing Sonniss foley pool used, so it keeps the -26 dBFS foley target with no mastering-table change. Shared flyby/impact clips: weapons/shared/<action>-NN.mp3 (-22 dBFS, see normalize_audio.sh).
